name: XAUUSD_H1_MOMENTUM_BREAKOUT

entry_rules.momentum_condition: body_pct_threshold >= 0.95 (top 5% momentum bars by body return)
entry_rules.description: Enter LONG on next H1 bar open when: (1) H1 EMA21 > EMA55 (bullish trend), (2) H1 body return is in top 5% of recent 60-bar range (strong up-momentum), (3) H1 ATR14/close >= 0.4% (active volatility).

stop.description: Stop = entry - 0.8x H1-ATR(14). Tighter stop for H1 context (vs 1.5x on D1).

description: H1 momentum breakout strategy: rides the confirmed H1 long bias using top-momentum hourly bars as entry trigger. Lot size from 2% risk per trade ($20 on $1,000). Upgraded from V11 D1 to H1 for more frequent signals while maintaining positive edge.
hypothesis: XAUUSD has a persistent long bias on H1 (EMA21>EMA55). Strong momentum hours (top 5% body) in bullish trend contexts produce continuation moves with positive expectancy after costs. H1 provides 14-16 signals per month (vs 1-2 on D1), enabling faster capital compounding while the 2% risk cap protects the account.

research_results.conclusion: H1 with R:R=3.0 is the SELECTED configuration (higher PF=2.20 vs 1.69 at R:R=2.0, same 14 trades). Positive expectancy with reasonable trade frequency. M1/M5/M15 all lose. D1 too sparse. H1 is the sweet spot.

notes: Research script: research/v11_multi_tf_jun_sep_2026.py — no MT5 writes, no live trading, no fabrication. All numbers computed from db/trading.db (H1 XAUUSD 10-year history, Jun-Sep 2026 test window). Cost model: round-trip ~0.013% on H1 (2x spread ~2.6 pips). Lot sizing: lots = $20 / (stop_pips * $10), rounded to 0.01.
